2023
Author: Krishan Pahal

High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Applicant :- Chatrapal @ S.K.
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others

Counsel for Applicant :- Ajay Kumar Pal,Kuldeep Singh Yadav
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Krishan Pahal,J.
1.
List has been revised.
2. Compliance affidavit filed today is taken on record.
3. Learned A.G.A. has informed that the notice to the information has been served on 05.02.2023.

4. Heard Shri Ajay Kumar Pal, learned counsel for the applicant as well as Shri V.K.S. Parmar,
learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
5.
Applicant seeks bail in Case Crime No.703 of 2022, under Sections 363, 366, 376 I.P.C. and 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Kotwali, District Mathura, during the pendency of trial.

sentences.text: As per prosecution story, the applicant is stated to have enticed away the minor daughter of the informant on 07.11.2022 between 1-3 pm when she had gone to attend her coaching classes.
It was also an apprehension that the maternal uncle of the applicant Ashok has helped in the said crime.
7. Learned counsel for the applicant has stated that the applicant is absolutely innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case.
The FIR is delayed by about one day and there is no explanation of the said delay caused.
The victim is a consenting party.

To buttress his arguments,
learned counsel has placed much reliance on the statement of the victim recorded u/s 164 Cr.P.C.,
whereby it is stated that on the instance of the applicant, the victim had gone alongwith him and travelled all the way to Jammu whereby the two are stated to have solemnized marriage and had lived as husband and wife.

Learned counsel has further stated that as per FIR and the age certificate,
the age of the victim is 17 years.
The same has been suppressed as she is major.
Learned counsel has further stated that a leverage of two years may be granted to the applicant on the upper side.
Several other submissions have been made on behalf of the applicant to demonstrate the falsity of the allegations made against him.
The circumstances which, as per counsel, led to the false implication of the applicant have also been touched upon at length.
There is no criminal history of the applicant.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 23.11.2022.
In case, the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail.
8. Per contra, learned A.G.A. has vehemently opposed the bail application but unable to dispute the submissions raised by the learned counsel for the applicant.

9. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for the parties, the evidence on record, and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.
The bail application is allowed.

10. Let the applicant- Chatrapal @ S.K. involved in aforementioned case crime number be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two heavy sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
(ii). The applicant will not pressurize/ intimidate the prosecution witness.
(iii) The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
(iv) The applicant shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which he is accused, or suspected of the commission of which he is suspected.

(v) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.

Identity, status and residence proof of the applicant and sureties be verified by the court concerned before the bonds are accepted.

12. It is made clear that observations made in granting bail to the applicant shall not in any way affect the learned trial Judge in forming his independent opinion based on the testimony of the witnesses.
